title: Be late again
simplified_paragraphs: 我和杨陈是2017年9月在学校认识的，他是我同学。他每天坐出租车去学校，我走去学校，每天车很多，他常常迟到。今年我们去上海旅游，他坐飞机，我坐火车，天气不好，飞机晚了，他又迟到了。
traditional_paragraphs: 我和楊陳是2017年9月在學校認識的，他是我同學。他每天坐出租車去學校，我走去學校，每天車很多，他常常遲到。今年我們去上海旅遊，他坐飛機，我坐火車，天氣不好，飛機晚了，他又遲到了。
pinyin_paragraphs: wǒ hé Yáng Chén shì 2017 nián 9 yuè zài xué xiào rèn shi de， tā shì wǒ tóng xué。 tā měi tiān zuò chū zū chē qù xué xiào， wǒ zǒu qù xué xiào， měi tiān chē hěn duō， tā cháng cháng chí dào。 jīn nián wǒ men qù Shàng hǎi lǚ yóu， tā zuò fēi jī， wǒ zuò huǒ chē， tiān qì bù hǎo， fēi jī wǎn le， tā yòu chí dào le。
english_paragraphs: I met Yang Chen at school in September 2017. He’s my classmate. He takes a taxi to school every day, while I walk. There’s a lot of traffic every day, so he’s often late. This year, we went to Shanghai on a trip. He flew, and I took the train. The weather was bad, so his flight was delayed, and he was late again.
english_full: I met Yang Chen at school in September 2017. He’s my classmate. He takes a taxi to school every day, while I walk. There’s a lot of traffic every day, so he’s often late. This year, we went to Shanghai on a trip. He flew, and I took the train. The weather was bad, so his flight was delayed, and he was late again.
